immediate_actions.title: Fixing Technical Issues
immediate_actions.description: We are logging and fixing every bug you reported — simulation sync issues, incorrect answer validation, and selection color visibility. If you flagged a specific question, it's being tracked and fixed.

immediate_actions.title: Replacing Drag-and-Drop for Grade 1
immediate_actions.description: For Grade 1 lessons, we are replacing drag-and-drop with more child friendly responses. We heard clearly that drag-and-drop is a barrier for young learners. Starting with "Magic with More Numbers" and "Together and Apart".

immediate_actions.title: Improving Language & Clarity
immediate_actions.description: Lessons flagged for confusing language or text-heavy explanations are being rewritten to be simpler and more age-appropriate.

planned_actions.title: Game-Based Practice Rounds
planned_actions.description: Many of you asked for Quizizz-style games, timed challenges, and point-based rewards. This is a bigger build that involves product and engineering — we're scoping it out and will share a timeline soon.

planned_actions.title: More Fun & Interactive Elements
planned_actions.description: Animated characters, story-based framing, and reward mechanics were requested across grades. We're exploring the best ways to weave these in without disrupting lesson flow.
